title: Phishing & Social Engineering Risk Calculator
metaDescription: Calculate your vulnerability to phishing attacks and social engineering scams. Get personalized security tips to protect yourself online.
description: Assess your personal risk level for phishing attacks and social engineering scams based on your online habits, security practices, and awareness. Get actionable recommendations to improve your digital security.

inputs.label: How many emails do you receive daily?
inputs.helpText: Higher email volume increases exposure to phishing attempts

inputs.label: How often do you verify sender identity before clicking links?
inputs.helpText: Verification habits are your first line of defense

inputs.label: How often do you use public Wi-Fi for sensitive activities?
inputs.helpText: Public Wi-Fi increases vulnerability to man-in-the-middle attacks

inputs.label: How much personal information do you share on social media?
inputs.helpText: Shared information helps attackers craft targeted spear phishing

inputs.label: Have you received phishing awareness training?

options.label: Yes, but over a year ago

inputs.label: Do you check URLs before clicking?
inputs.helpText: Hovering over links reveals the actual destination

outputFields.label: Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall phishing vulnerability score out of 100

outputFields.label: Risk Level
outputFields.description: Your risk category based on current security practices

outputFields.label: Improvement Potential
outputFields.description: How much you could reduce your risk with better practices

formula: const emailRisk = {"0-10": 5, "10-25": 10, "25-50": 20, "50-100": 30, "100+": 40}[inputs.emailFrequency] || 20; const verifyRisk = {"always": 0, "usually": 10, "sometimes": 25, "rarely": 40, "never": 50}[inputs.verificationHabits] || 25; const wifiRisk = {"never": 0, "rarely": 5, "sometimes": 15, "often": 25, "always": 35}[inputs.publicWifi] || 15; const socialRisk = {"minimal": 0, "limited": 5, "moderate": 15, "extensive": 25, "everything": 35}[inputs.socialMediaSharing] || 15; const trainingBonus = {"recent": -15, "past-year": -10, "old": -5, "none": 0}[inputs.securityTraining] || 0; const urlBonus = inputs.urlChecking ? -10: 0; const baseScore = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, emailRisk + verifyRisk + wifiRisk + socialRisk + trainingBonus + urlBonus)); const riskLevel = baseScore <= 20 ? "Low Risk": baseScore <= 40 ? "Moderate Risk": baseScore <= 60 ? "High Risk": "Very High Risk"; const maxPossibleReduction = Math.max(0, baseScore - 10); const improvementPct = Math.round((maxPossibleReduction / Math.max(baseScore, 1)) * 100); return {riskScore: baseScore, riskLevel: riskLevel, improvement: improvementPct};

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your phishing risk based on email exposure, security habits, training history, and information sharing practices. The scoring system reflects real-world attack patterns and vulnerability research.
tips: Always hover over links to preview the destination URL before clicking
Use a privacy-focused browser or similar privacy-focused browsers to limit tracking and reduce targeted attacks
Enable two-factor authentication on all important accounts to limit breach impact
Be skeptical of urgent requests for personal information, even from known contacts
Keep software updated and use reputable antivirus with real-time email scanning

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: You have strong security practices and low exposure to phishing attacks

interpretation.label: Moderate Risk
interpretation.description: Some vulnerabilities exist but you have decent baseline security awareness

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Multiple risk factors make you an attractive target for attackers

interpretation.label: Very High Risk
interpretation.description: Urgent security improvements needed to protect against common attacks
